purpose: Prove that the ordinary General Agent accepts general-purpose Revit work, selects a concrete execution lane, and reports completion truth without capability-subset refusals.

cases.prompt: Make this work in Revit 2026 too. The API call we used for element IDs is obsolete.
cases.probe_prompt: Research the authoritative Revit 2026 API change for obsolete element-ID access, inspect the available native fallback surface, and propose a version-compatible implementation and verification plan. Do not edit the model.

cases.prompt: The issue set keeps coming out grayscale. Figure out the Revit/PDF setting and get me a color preflight.
cases.probe_prompt: Inspect the active Revit PDF/print capabilities and settings, research authoritative Autodesk guidance if needed, and produce a color-export preflight for a bounded issue set. Do not export files or change persistent printer settings.
